initiatives.name: Mendocino County Safe Space Project
initiatives.description: Fort Bragg nonprofit serving LGBTQIA+ people in Mendocino County with support groups, youth scholarships, a gender care closet and safe-space trainings.

initiatives.name: Mendocino County AIDS/Viral Hepatitis Network (MCAVHN)
initiatives.description: Ukiah-based nonprofit serving Mendocino County, offering HIV and hepatitis C support, syringe exchange and other harm reduction services, crisis counseling, and referrals.
